items.prompt: Your flight has been delayed by three hours. A friend texts to ask how you are. Which reply fits best?
options: Fine, honestly. I've got a book and a coffee, all good.
Three hours! Unbelievable. I've had it with this airline.
items.target: Fine, honestly. I've got a book and a coffee, all good.

items.prompt: A colleague asks how you feel about tomorrow's presentation. Which reply fits best?
options: I've gone over it once; I'll take it as it comes.
I keep going over it, sure something will go wrong.
items.target: I've gone over it once; I'll take it as it comes.

items.prompt: Your partner asks how your morning was. Which reply fits best?
options: Slow and easy. Coffee on the step, a walk, nothing pressing.
Packed! Coffee on the run, a walk, then straight into work.
items.target: Slow and easy. Coffee on the step, a walk, nothing pressing.

items.prompt: A friend asks how you're handling the house renovation. Which reply fits best?
options: The kitchen is done, and the bathroom starts next month.
The kitchen is done, the bathroom can wait. It's all fine.
items.target: The kitchen is done, the bathroom can wait. It's all fine.

items.prompt: Your child knocks over a vase and it breaks. Which reply fits best?
options: Things break. Let's sweep it up together, no fuss.
Look at this mess! How many times have I told you?
items.target: Things break. Let's sweep it up together, no fuss.

items.prompt: A teammate asks what to do now the server is down. Which reply fits best?
options: First, check the logs. We'll work through it one step at a time.
Oh no, oh no. Check everything, this could be a disaster.
items.target: First, check the logs. We'll work through it one step at a time.

items.prompt: Your friend asks how the week of camping was. Which reply fits best?
options: Lovely and slow. Fire at night, the lake at dawn, no clocks.
Brilliant fun! Fire at night, the lake at dawn, we laughed loads.
items.target: Lovely and slow. Fire at night, the lake at dawn, no clocks.

items.prompt: Your neighbour's music is loud late at night. You text them. Which message fits best?
options: It's midnight. Turn it down right now, this is ridiculous.
Hi, could you turn it down a little? Thanks, sleep well.
items.target: Hi, could you turn it down a little? Thanks, sleep well.

items.prompt: A friend asks how you feel about turning fifty. Which reply fits best?
options: Good, really. Comfortable in my skin and in no rush.
Odd. I keep thinking of all the years that slipped by.
items.target: Good, really. Comfortable in my skin and in no rush.

items.prompt: Your boss asks how the deadline is looking. Which reply fits best?
options: We're on track, I think, but I'm losing sleep over the loose ends.
We're on track. A few loose ends, nothing to lose sleep over.
items.target: We're on track. A few loose ends, nothing to lose sleep over.

items.prompt: A friend asks what your Sunday was like. Which reply fits best?
options: I did the shopping, cooked lunch, and read for an hour.
I pottered about, cooked lunch slowly, and read for an hour.
items.target: I pottered about, cooked lunch slowly, and read for an hour.

items.prompt: Your sister says the train you're both on has stopped in a tunnel. Which reply fits best?
options: Why have we stopped? What if we're stuck for hours?
It'll move soon. Let's just sit back and wait.
items.target: It'll move soon. Let's just sit back and wait.

items.prompt: A coworker asks how you get through busy days. Which reply fits best?
options: I go hard, take five things at once, and keep the pace up.
I breathe, take one thing at a time, and let the rest wait.
items.target: I breathe, take one thing at a time, and let the rest wait.

items.prompt: Your mother asks how the first night in the new flat went. Which reply fits best?
options: It was quiet, Mum. I sat alone and felt very far from home.
It was quiet, Mum. I sat by the window and slept soundly.
items.target: It was quiet, Mum. I sat by the window and slept soundly.

items.prompt: A friend asks about your new job in the countryside. Which reply fits best?
options: It suits me. Quiet office, long lunches, a slower kind of day.
It's fine. Small office, an hour for lunch, finish at five.
items.target: It suits me. Quiet office, long lunches, a slower kind of day.

items.prompt: Your doctor asks how you've been since the last visit. Which reply fits best?
options: Mostly fine, but I keep imagining the worst between visits.
Mostly fine. I sleep well and take each day as it comes.
items.target: Mostly fine. I sleep well and take each day as it comes.
